Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
830 AM EST Thu Nov 5 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 PM EST THIS EVENING...

.TODAY...S winds 10 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. Scattered
showers early this morning, then isolated showers and tstms this
afternoon. 
.TONIGHT...S winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. Showers with a
chance of tstms. Patchy fog. 
.FRI...NW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming NE late. Waves 1 ft. Showers
likely. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.FRI NIGHT...N winds 5 kt...becoming NW 10 to 15 kt after midnight.
Waves flat...building to 2 ft after midnight. 
.SAT...NW winds 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SUN...W winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.MON...W winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
